ordering: Original UIEBDataset lexicographic sorted input filenames
split_rule: Historical sorted indices 800:890 reserved; shuffle filename-ordered duplicate groups among indices 0:800 with Python Random(split_seed); exact subset-sum allocation of 80 validation, remaining 720 training

audit.near_rule: For both input and reference: dHash distance <=3 AND aligned RGB 16x16 thumbnail MSE <=0.000625. Candidates include exact matches; no assertion of scene independence.
audit.decision: Conservatively group detected duplicates within first 800; preserve historical test90. Detection does not guarantee scene independence.
